category_title: Students performing closed challenges through overt off-task social interaction
scenario_title: Overt off-task conversation during competitive homework check
minimal_context: The student is participating in a daily competitive homework checking game where she needs to match a paragraph number to a main idea in her book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start our daily homework check game. Lisa, you are up for this round. Please read out loud which paragraph number on the right matches the main idea on the left for Item (b), 'Our five senses'.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns to Brent, the male student sitting in front of me, and starts overtly talking to him)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Lisa, it is your turn for the game. Do you have the answer?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sam taps my hand and points to Item b in his book. I look down at my own book, but I do not look at Sam's pointing)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Lisa, we are waiting for you to read the paragraph number.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues speaking with Brent, completely ignoring the fact that my name has been called for the game)
